title: ToggleSP
description: Quickly switch Sneak and Sprint between Hold and Toggle using configurable keybinds
body:
# ToggleSP

ToggleSP is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod for Minecraft 1.21+ that allows you to quickly switch Sneak and Sprint between Hold and Toggle modes using configurable keybinds.

---

## Features

- Toggle Sneak mode (Hold ↔ Toggle)
- Toggle Sprint mode (Hold ↔ Toggle)
- Separate keybinds for each action
- Settings are saved even after closing the game (saved via Minecraft options)
- On-screen HUD notifications

---

## Controls

You can configure keybinds in: Options → Controls → ToggleSP

(Default bindings are unassigned)
